messages:
Sam (People Ops): Quick preboard checklist for Leah's new hire (Casey) starting Mon. Keeping this terse so ops can action.

Preboard (today):
- Confirm legal name + preferred display name. Mira to verify docs.
- Device & badge: Jordan to confirm courier vs pickup.
- Calendar: 1:1 series, team kickoff, product intro, 30/60/90 draft slot.
- Slack + docs groups: add to #eng-team, #pm, #new-hires.
- OnboardBot: create checklist and tag Omar as buddy.

Day 1 (non-burn):
- 10:00: HR mini-intro (Mira) 	6: benefits & payroll quick wins.
- 11:00: Team quick intros (15m) 	6 no slides.
- 13:00: Product tour with buddy (Omar).
- 15:00: Manager 1:1 (Leah) to set initial expectations and 30d priorities.

Week 1 aims:
- Complete SSO + MFA + security training.
- Shadow 1 customer call or support thread.
- Deliver a 1-page "first sprint snapshot": observed friction, 3 quick experiments.

30/60/90 (measurable milestones):
- 30d: Own one small feature spec and ship an improvement or A/B plan.
- 60d: Lead cross-functional execution on the spec; show metric movement.
- 90d: Propose next roadmap steps and measurable OKR contribution.

Logistics & quick links:
- HR portal: https://hr.redwood.local/onboard (Mira)
- Device pickup: security desk or courier (Jordan)
- Console access form: /forms/console-access (Leah include GitHub handle)

Leah (Eng Manager): Thanks Sam. I'll send the intro email now and block a 30m sync day 2 for handoff. Omar confirmed buddy slot at 13:00.

Jordan (IT): Laptop (14" MBP) imaged. Badge printed. Pickup 09:30 or courier option. Need GitHub handle for team sync and phone for MFA, or we issue hardware key.

Mira (HR): Sending HR invite. Please upload ID docs within 48h to avoid payroll delay.

Omar (Buddy): I'll prepare a 30-min product walkthrough and a template for the "first sprint snapshot" so Casey has a clear deliverable.

OnboardBot: Checklist created OB-1812345678 with reminders at day 3 and day 7. Link: https://onboard.redwood.local/checklist/OB-1812345678

Sam (People Ops): Closing preboard unless blockers. Reply here if anything changes overnight. :thumbsup:
